profile.reading: Digital Fortress Portland 1, facility code PTL, is a Digital Fortress data center in downtown Portland, Oregon. Digital Fortress's own dedicated page for this facility, fetched directly from digital-fortress.com, describes 6,700 square feet of raised floor data center space with 2.1 megawatts of power capacity, and states the building is adjacent to the Pittock Block Carrier Hotel, which the operator describes as the second most connected building in the Pacific Northwest, with 16 fiber optic carriers and 179 service providers connected on site and membership in the Northwest Access Exchange (NWAX). The operator's own page lists SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II compliance and describes biometric scan, key card, and CCTV physical security. A separate Digital Fortress press release, also fetched directly from the operator's own site, dated January 19, 2021, documents that Digital Fortress acquired this facility along with two sibling Beaverton, Oregon buildings in this registry, Portland 2 and Portland 3, from Atmosera Inc.'s colocation business, transferring more than 100 colocation customers in the deal. The press release describes the region's data center advantage as direct access to seven subsea cables, positioning the Portland area as a connectivity gateway to Asia Pacific markets. No confirmed street address for this specific building has been found from Digital Fortress's own materials. The address on file here comes from a reverse geocode of this registry's stored coordinates rather than an operator or government primary source, and should be treated as an approximation pending stronger corroboration, though it is consistent with the operator's own description of a downtown Portland location. Digital Fortress is a colocation data center operator and a portfolio company of Chirisa Investments, which also owns the Piscataway, New Jersey, Richmond, Virginia, and Lynnwood, Washington facilities already on file elsewhere in this registry under the same operator.

reading.body:
Digital Fortress Portland 1 sits in downtown Portland on Southwest 10th Avenue, but the operator's specifications remain inaccessible. No capacity figure, power draw, square footage, or facility class has been published. The operator's website has not been reachable, and no secondary source describing this facility could be found.

Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which only 8 publish power capacity figures totaling 156.6 megawatts. This campus would rank ninth by published megawatts if its capacity were known, placing it below the state's disclosed tier. Without a published figure, it cannot be assessed against either the state's grid or the broader scaling constraint that binds AI infrastructure.

Until the operator publishes specifications or a secondary source documents this facility's capacity and power draw, Digital Fortress Portland 1 cannot be read as a material point in the geography of AI compute. The facility exists at a known address but remains opaque to capacity planning.
